tables.name: a_delivery_receipts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_delivery_receipts (
    receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    provider_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    UNIQUE(provider_subject,provider_event_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_executions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_executions (
    execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt>0),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    UNIQUE(task_id,attempt)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_in_app_notifications
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_in_app_notifications (
    notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_executions(execution_id),
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_ref TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_reminder_contents(content_ref),
    submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_simulated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_simulated=1)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_notice_consumptions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_notice_consumptions (
    notice_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES change_notices(notice_id),
    consumer TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','applied','ignored','failed')),
    result_ref TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(notice_id,consumer)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_notification_recipients
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_notification_recipients (
    notification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_in_app_notifications(notification_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES o_accounts(account_id),
    grant_id TEXT,
    grant_version INTEGER,
    submission_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(submission_status='submitted'),
    PRIMARY KEY(notification_id,account_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_reminder_contents
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_reminder_contents (
    content_ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dose_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dose_slots(dose_slot_id),
    reminder_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reminder_revision>0),
    text_content TEXT NOT NULL,
    privacy_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(privacy_enabled IN (0,1)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: a_reminder_snooze_links
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_reminder_snooze_links (
    source_task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    source_task_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_task_revision>0),
    child_task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    dose_slot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dose_slots(dose_slot_id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(source_task_id,source_task_revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_task_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_task_history (
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY(task_id,revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_task_leases
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_task_leases (
    task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    owner_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    claim_token INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(claim_token>0),
    claimed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    lease_until TEXT NOT NULL,
    phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('claimed','side_effect_started','result_saved'))
) STRICT

tables.name: a_task_run_receipt_links
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_task_run_receipt_links (
    receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES idempotency_receipts(receipt_id),
    execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a_executions(execution_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: a_tasks
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE a_tasks (
    task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(data_environment IN ('demo','real')),
    owner_module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_module IN ('O','A','B','C')),
    owner_operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    creator_account_id TEXT,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    UNIQUE(data_environment,owner_module,owner_operation_key)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_generation_runs
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_generation_runs (
    generation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES b_generations(generation_id),
    run_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(run_number >= 1),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('accepted','running','completed','failed','cancelled','outcome_unknown')),
    PRIMARY KEY(generation_id, run_number)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_generations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_generations (
    generation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    user_message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES b_messages(message_id),
    run_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(run_number >= 1),
    scenario TEXT,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    output_json TEXT CHECK(output_json IS NULL OR json_valid(output_json))
) STRICT

tables.name: b_intervention_revisions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_intervention_revisions (
    intervention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 1),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: b_knowledge
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_knowledge (
    knowledge_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal >= 1),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY(knowledge_id, version),
    UNIQUE(knowledge_id, ordinal)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_knowledge_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_knowledge_history (
    knowledge_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 1),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY(knowledge_id, version, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_id, version) REFERENCES b_knowledge(knowledge_id, version)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_messages
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_messages (
    message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_message_id TEXT,
    source_message_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES b_messages(message_id),
    request_fingerprint TEXT,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    FOREIGN KEY(session_id, patient_id) REFERENCES b_sessions(session_id, patient_id),
    UNIQUE(session_id, client_message_id),
    CHECK((client_message_id IS NOT NULL AND source_message_id IS NULL AND request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL)
       OR (client_message_id IS NULL AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL AND request_fingerprint IS NULL))
) STRICT

tables.name: b_model_selection
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_model_selection (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json))
) STRICT

tables.name: b_records
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_records (
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('Assessment','UIState','ModeChange','Invitation','InvitationResponse',
        'Intervention','Suggestion','SuggestionResponse','DisplayReceipt','Referral','Integration',
        'ScenarioRun','CheckinNode','Retrieval','Probe','Reset')),
    record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT,
    session_id TEXT,
    source_key TEXT,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY(kind, record_id),
    UNIQUE(kind, source_key),
    FOREIGN KEY(session_id, patient_id) REFERENCES b_sessions(session_id, patient_id),
    CHECK(session_id IS NULL OR patient_id IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_rule_selection
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_rule_selection (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
    version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES b_rule_versions(version),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
    selected_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: b_rule_selection_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_rule_selection_history (
    selection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    previous_version TEXT,
    selected_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES b_rule_versions(version),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(revision>=1),
    cancelled_invitations INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cancelled_invitations>=0),
    selected_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    selected_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: b_rule_versions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_rule_versions (
    version TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=1),
    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(profile_id, ordinal)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_sessions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    case_id TEXT,
    invitation_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
    UNIQUE(session_id, patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: b_star_checkpoints
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE b_star_checkpoints (
    generation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES b_generations(generation_id),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json))
) STRICT

tables.name: c_confirmation_revocations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_confirmation_revocations (
    confirmation_ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES c_service_confirmations(confirmation_ref_id),
    actor_account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES o_accounts(account_id),
    revoked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: c_draft_confirmations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_draft_confirmations (
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    draft_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    confirmation_ref_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    linked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (service_draft_id, draft_revision, confirmation_ref_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_draft_id, patient_id)
        REFERENCES c_service_drafts (service_draft_id, patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_draft_id, draft_revision)
        REFERENCES c_service_draft_revisions (service_draft_id, draft_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (confirmation_ref_id, patient_id)
        REFERENCES c_service_confirmations (confirmation_ref_id, patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_fulfillment_receipts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_fulfillment_receipts (
    subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    fulfillment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_reward_fulfillments(fulfillment_id),
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operation_audit(operation_id),
    ack_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(ack_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY (subject,provider_event_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_management_reviews
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_management_reviews (
    review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES o_accounts(account_id),
    week_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_review_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    reflection TEXT,
    completed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (patient_id,week_start),
    UNIQUE (patient_id,client_review_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_groups
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_groups (
    group_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES c_support_resources(resource_id),
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(document_json) AND json_type(document_json)='object'
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.group_id') IS group_id
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.resource_id') IS resource_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_membership_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_membership_history (
    membership_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_peer_memberships(membership_id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','active','left')),
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(document_json)
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.membership_id') IS membership_id
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.meta.revision') IS revision
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.status') IS status),
    PRIMARY KEY (membership_id,revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_memberships
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_memberships (
    membership_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    group_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_peer_groups(group_id),
    service_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    alias TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','active','left')),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
    UNIQUE (group_id,alias),
    UNIQUE (membership_id,group_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id,patient_id) REFERENCES c_services(service_id,patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_moderators
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_moderators (
    group_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_peer_groups(group_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES o_accounts(account_id),
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id, account_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_post_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_post_history (
    post_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_peer_posts(post_id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision>=1),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','visible','hidden')),
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((revision=1 AND status='pending' AND reason IS NULL)
        OR (revision>1 AND status IN ('visible','hidden') AND reason IS NOT NULL)),
    PRIMARY KEY (post_id,revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_peer_posts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_peer_posts (
    post_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    group_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    membership_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_post_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (membership_id,client_post_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (membership_id,group_id) REFERENCES c_peer_memberships(membership_id,group_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_points_accounts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_points_accounts (
    points_account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision>=1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (points_account_id,patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_points_award_sources
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_points_award_sources (
    ledger_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    rule_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    module TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_revision>=1),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    anchor_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    qualification_ref TEXT,
    source_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_order>=1),
    CHECK ((module='A' AND record_kind='event' AND rule_code IN ('daily_record','five_day_block'))
        OR (module='C' AND record_kind='management_review' AND rule_code='weekly_review')
        OR (module='C' AND record_kind='peer_post' AND rule_code='peer_participation')),
    PRIMARY KEY (ledger_id,source_order),
    UNIQUE (patient_id,rule_code,module,record_kind,record_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ledger_id,patient_id,rule_code) REFERENCES c_points_ledger(ledger_id,patient_id,rule_code)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_points_date_allocations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_points_date_allocations (
    allocation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    rule_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (rule_code='five_day_block'),
    local_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    ledger_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (patient_id,rule_code,local_date),
    FOREIGN KEY (ledger_id,patient_id,rule_code) REFERENCES c_points_ledger(ledger_id,patient_id,rule_code)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_points_ledger
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_points_ledger (
    ledger_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    points_account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operation_audit(operation_id),
    entry_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_kind IN ('award','redemption_debit','redemption_refund')),
    delta INTEGER NOT NULL,
    balance_after INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (balance_after>=0),
    business_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(business_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    rule_code TEXT CHECK (rule_code IN ('daily_record','five_day_block','weekly_review','peer_participation')),
    period_start TEXT,
    rules_version TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    redemption_id TEXT REFERENCES c_redemptions(redemption_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    reverses_ledger_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES c_points_ledger(ledger_id),
    CHECK ((entry_kind='award' AND delta>0 AND rule_code IS NOT NULL AND period_start IS NOT NULL
            AND rules_version IS NOT NULL AND redemption_id IS NULL AND reverses_ledger_id IS NULL)
        OR (entry_kind='redemption_debit' AND delta<0 AND rule_code IS NULL AND period_start IS NULL
            AND rules_version IS NULL AND redemption_id IS NOT NULL AND reverses_ledger_id IS NULL)
        OR (entry_kind='redemption_refund' AND delta>0 AND rule_code IS NULL AND period_start IS NULL
            AND rules_version IS NULL AND redemption_id IS NOT NULL AND reverses_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)),
    UNIQUE (redemption_id,entry_kind),
    UNIQUE (patient_id,business_key),
    UNIQUE (patient_id,rule_code,period_start),
    UNIQUE (ledger_id,patient_id,rule_code),
    FOREIGN KEY (points_account_id,patient_id) REFERENCES c_points_accounts(points_account_id,patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_points_reconciliations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_points_reconciliations (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES operation_audit(operation_id),
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_points_accounts(patient_id),
    window_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    window_end TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (window_end>window_start),
    rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_issues_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_issues_json) AND json_type(source_issues_json)='array'),
    source_changes_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_changes_json) AND json_type(source_changes_json)='array')
) STRICT

tables.name: c_redemption_feedback
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_redemption_feedback (
    feedback_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    redemption_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_redemptions(redemption_id),
    client_feedback_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(document_json)),
    UNIQUE (redemption_id,client_feedback_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_redemption_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_redemption_history (
    redemption_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_redemptions(redemption_id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision>=1),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    redemption_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(redemption_json)),
    fulfillment_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(fulfillment_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY (redemption_id,revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_redemption_notices
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_redemption_notices (
    redemption_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (redemption_id,revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (redemption_id,revision) REFERENCES c_redemption_history(redemption_id,revision)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_redemptions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_redemptions (
    redemption_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_points_accounts(patient_id),
    reward_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reward_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    debit_ledger_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES c_points_ledger(ledger_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    service_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES c_services(service_id),
    fulfillment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    redeemed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (account_revision>=1),
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (patient_id,account_revision),
    UNIQUE (redemption_id,fulfillment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reward_id,reward_version) REFERENCES c_reward_versions(reward_id,reward_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (fulfillment_id) REFERENCES c_reward_fulfillments(fulfillment_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
) STRICT

tables.name: c_reward_fulfillments
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_reward_fulfillments (
    fulfillment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    redemption_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    FOREIGN KEY (redemption_id,fulfillment_id) REFERENCES c_redemptions(redemption_id,fulfillment_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_reward_versions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_reward_versions (
    reward_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reward_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    previous_version TEXT,
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    reward_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(reward_json)),
    template_text TEXT,
    resource_version TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (reward_id,reward_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (reward_id,previous_version) REFERENCES c_reward_versions(reward_id,reward_version)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_rewards
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_rewards (
    reward_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    current_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reward_id,current_version) REFERENCES c_reward_versions(reward_id,reward_version)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_service_confirmations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_service_confirmations (
    confirmation_ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    descriptor_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(descriptor_hash)=64),
    origin_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_draft_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sharing_scope_ref_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_until TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (valid_until > confirmed_at),
    UNIQUE (confirmation_ref_id, patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_draft_id, patient_id)
        REFERENCES c_service_drafts (service_draft_id, patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_draft_id, origin_draft_revision)
        REFERENCES c_service_draft_revisions (service_draft_id, draft_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (resource_id, resource_version)
        REFERENCES c_support_resource_versions (resource_id, resource_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (sharing_scope_ref_id, patient_id)
        REFERENCES o_sharing_scopes (sharing_scope_ref_id, patient_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_service_dispatches
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_service_dispatches (
    dispatch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    service_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES c_services(service_id),
    task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES a_tasks(task_id),
    execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES a_executions(execution_id),
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('mock_submission','mock_provider_receipt')),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: c_service_draft_revisions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_service_draft_revisions (
    service_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_service_drafts(service_draft_id),
    draft_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (draft_revision >= 1),
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
    author_account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES o_accounts(account_id),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (service_draft_id, draft_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (resource_id, resource_version)
        REFERENCES c_support_resource_versions (resource_id, resource_version)
) STRICT

tables.name: c_service_drafts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_service_drafts (
    service_draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    draft_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (draft_revision >= 1),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= draft_revision),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preparing'
    CHECK (status IN ('preparing','submitted','abandoned')), service_id TEXT REFERENCES c_services(service_id),
    UNIQUE (service_draft_id, patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_draft_id, draft_revision)
        REFERENCES c_service_draft_revisions (service_draft_id, draft_revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
) STRICT

tables.name: c_service_feedback
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_service_feedback (
    feedback_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    service_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_services(service_id),

    supersedes_feedback_id TEXT REFERENCES c_service_feedback(feedback_id),
    client_feedback_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(document_json) AND json_type(document_json)='object'
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.feedback_id') IS feedback_id
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.service_id') IS service_id
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.feedback_revision') IS feedback_revision
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.supersedes_feedback_id') IS supersedes_feedback_id
        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.recorded_at') IS recorded_at),
    UNIQUE (service_id, feedback_revision),
    UNIQUE (service_id, client_feedback_id)
) STRICT

    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('patient_submit','b_referral','patient_cancel','demo_transition','provider_receipt')),

        AND json_extract(document_json,'$.service_id') IS service_id

tables.name: c_support_resource_versions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE c_support_resource_versions (
    resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    previous_version TEXT,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    fixture_source TEXT NOT NULL,
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (review_status = 'not_reviewed'),
    resource_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        json_valid(resource_json)
        AND json_extract(resource_json, '$.resource_id') IS resource_id
        AND json_extract(resource_json, '$.resource_version') IS resource_version
        AND json_type(resource_json, '$.is_simulated') IS 'true'
        AND json_type(resource_json, '$.provider.is_simulated') IS 'true'
    ),
    profile_types_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        json_valid(profile_types_json) AND json_type(profile_types_json) = 'array'
    ),
    PRIMARY KEY (resource_id, resource_version),
    FOREIGN KEY (resource_id, previous_version)
        REFERENCES c_support_resource_versions (resource_id, resource_version),
    CHECK (previous_version IS NULL OR previous_version <> resource_version)
) STRICT

tables.name: event_revisions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE event_revisions (
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_events(event_id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
    change_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(change_kind IN ('original','correction','withdrawal')),
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json)='object'),
    reason TEXT,
    replaces_revision INTEGER,
    actor_account_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_simulated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_simulated IN (0,1)),
    CHECK((change_kind='original' AND revision=1 AND replaces_revision IS NULL)
       OR (change_kind IN ('correction','withdrawal') AND revision>1 AND replaces_revision IS NOT NULL AND replaces_revision<revision AND length(trim(reason))>0 AND reason IS NOT NULL)),
    PRIMARY KEY(event_id, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY(event_id, is_simulated) REFERENCES source_events(event_id, is_simulated),
    FOREIGN KEY(event_id, replaces_revision) REFERENCES event_revisions(event_id, revision)
) STRICT

    FOREIGN KEY(patient_id, data_environment, dose_slot_id) REFERENCES dose_slots(patient_id, data_environment, dose_slot_id)

tables.name: source_events
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE source_events (
    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(data_environment IN ('demo','real')),
    event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('medication','measurement')),
    source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('manual','box','wearable')),
    source_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_type TEXT,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    reporter_account_id TEXT,
    device_id TEXT,
    original_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(original_payload_json) AND json_type(original_payload_json)='object'),
    is_simulated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_simulated = (data_environment = 'demo')),
    CHECK((source='manual' AND reporter_account_id IS NOT NULL AND device_id IS NULL)
       OR (source IN ('box','wearable') AND reporter_account_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(source_subject_id = COALESCE(reporter_account_id, device_id)),
    CHECK((event_kind='measurement' AND evidence_type IS NULL)
       OR (event_kind='medication' AND evidence_type IS NOT NULL AND source='manual' AND evidence_type IN ('self_report','family_report'))
       OR (event_kind='medication' AND evidence_type IS NOT NULL AND source IN ('box','wearable') AND evidence_type IN ('box_opening','device_inference'))),
    UNIQUE(patient_id, data_environment, event_id),
    UNIQUE(event_id, is_simulated),
    UNIQUE(patient_id, data_environment, source, source_subject_id, source_event_id)
) STRICT
